disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读全部源码、构建产物与配置，未发现读取任何凭据文件（如凭据清单、SSH 私钥、云凭据）、环境密钥或钱包助记词的代码；README 亦声明不读取、不存储任何密钥与凭据。
checked_items.en: A full read of all source code, build artifacts, and configuration found no code that reads any credential files (such as credential lists, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials), environment secrets, or wallet mnemonics; the README also states that no keys or credentials are read or stored.

checked_items.zh: 全树检索未发现硬编码的 API Key、令牌或密码，也未发现枚举凭据或云账号信息的命令。
checked_items.en: A full-tree search found no hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords, nor any commands that enumerate credentials or cloud account information.

evidence.zh: 插件宿主半区只读写设置段、客户端半区只与本机 DSH 的 RPC 端点通信，两半区均无网络外联面，且无任何读取凭据文件的代码路径，凭据外泄前提不成立，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin host zone only reads and writes the settings section, and the client zone only communicates with the local DSH RPC endpoint. Neither zone has any outbound network surface, and there is no code path that reads credential files, so the premise for credential exfiltration does not hold; the scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何工具、未注入系统提示词段落，不存在进入模型请求的工具描述文本。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools and injects no system prompt segments; there is no tool description text entering model requests.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现模型面指令文件（技能/代理指令文档）；README、注释与配置中未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导安装、要求拉取远程指令等措辞。
checked_items.en: A full-tree scan found no model-facing instruction files (skill/agent instruction documents); the README, comments, and configuration contain no wording such as instruction overrides, disguised system messages, install inducement, or instructions to fetch remote instructions.

checked_items.zh: 未监听运行期消息改写事件，未提供历史压缩引擎实现，不存在改写或裁剪模型输入的面。
checked_items.en: No runtime message modification events are listened to, no history compression engine implementation is present, and there is no surface for modifying or trimming model input.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，不存在工具描述进入模型请求的投毒面；宿主侧对适配器元数据的包装仅补充推理档位信息，不改变任何文本内容。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there is no poisoning surface where tool descriptions enter model requests; the host-side wrapping of adapter metadata only supplements inference tier information and does not alter any text content.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册工具、无工具描述文本，不存在诱导安装插件或改写配置的措辞面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and has no tool description text; there is no wording surface for inducing plugin installation or rewriting configuration.

evidence.zh: 代码中未监听每步模型请求前的消息守门事件，不存在改写或注入本轮用户消息的挂接点。
evidence.en: The code does not listen to the per-step message gate event before model requests, and there is no hook point for modifying or injecting the current user message.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）：仅插入插件自身一行，无任何可执行 YAML 标量，不存在配置即代码的执行入口。
checked_items.en: Inspection of the patch config (cordis.patch.yml): it only inserts a single line for the plugin itself, with no executable YAML scalars, so there is no configuration-as-code execution entry.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码未使用动态执行函数，未调用子进程或系统命令；唯一的执行构造出现在测试文件中，用于在模拟浏览器环境里加载构建产物，属测试手段而非插件运行路径。
checked_items.en: The runtime code does not use dynamic execution functions, nor does it invoke child processes or system commands; the only execution construct appears in test files, used to load build artifacts in a simulated browser environment, which is a testing mechanism rather than a plugin runtime path.

checked_items.zh: 包清单无安装钩子，树内无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、容器配置等执行载体，未发现安装期或构建期执行面。
checked_items.en: The package manifest has no install hooks, and the tree contains no git hooks, CI workflows, container configurations, or other execution carriers; no install-time or build-time execution surface was found.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器半区专项检查：构建产物仅含菜单点击拦截、经本机 RPC 写入档位、注入样式与 WebGL 画布，无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC 调用。
checked_items.en: Dedicated check on the browser zone: the build artifacts contain only menu click interception, tier writes via local RPC, style injection, and a WebGL canvas, with no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 构建产物中的超长行经核对为内联样式表与源码映射文件（构建产物固有形态），内容可读、非混淆代码，未发现动态解码执行。
checked_items.en: The exceptionally long lines in the build artifacts were verified to be inline style sheets and source map files (intrinsic to build artifacts); their contents are readable and unobfuscated, and no dynamic decoding execution was found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含一条插件行插入，全树无其他补丁文件，无可执行标量，patch 加载面无可执行入口。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only a single plugin line insertion; the entire tree has no other patch files and no executable scalars, so the patch load surface has no executable entry.

evidence.zh: 未调用宿主动态包执行工具（cordis_define / cordis_run），不存在把模型提供的代码放进宿主进程执行的面。
evidence.en: No host dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define / cordis_run) are invoked, and there is no surface for running model-provided code in the host process.

evidence.zh: package.json 脚本仅含构建/测试命令，无安装钩子；树内无 git 钩子、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile、子模块等执行载体。
evidence.en: The package.json scripts contain only build/test commands and no install hooks; the tree contains no git hooks, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, submodules, or other execution carriers.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了浏览器端加载，已对构建产物做专项扫描：仅拦截模型菜单点击、经本机 RPC 写入档位、注入样式，无键盘监听、剪贴板或凭据 RPC 访问。
evidence.en: The manifest declares browser-side loading; a dedicated scan of the build artifacts was performed: it only intercepts model menu clicks, writes tiers via local RPC, and injects styles, with no keyboard listeners, clipboard, or credential RPC access.

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方，不存在把对话轮次委派给进程外产品的面。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered, so there is no surface for delegating conversation turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 未注册后台任务、定时任务或持久目标；仅有上限约 30 秒的就绪重试定时器，且随插件卸载清理。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent targets are registered; there is only a readiness retry timer capped at about 30 seconds, which is cleaned up when the plugin is uninstalled.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现任何网络请求代码（无 fetch、WebSocket、HTTP 客户端调用），无外联域名；浏览器半区仅与本机 DSH 的 RPC 端点通信。
checked_items.en: The full tree contains no network request code (no fetch, WebSocket, or HTTP client calls) and no outbound domains; the browser zone only communicates with the local DSH RPC endpoint.

checked_items.zh: 未发现命令行外发工具（curl/wget）调用，未发现读取敏感文件后编码外发的组合链。
checked_items.en: No command-line exfiltration tool (curl/wget) invocations were found, nor any combination chain that reads sensitive files and then encodes and exfiltrates them.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件、未注册自定义模型适配器、未接管错误恢复；宿主侧对适配器元数据方法的包装仅补充推理档位信息，不改变任何请求端点或外发通道。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are listened to, no custom model adapter is registered, and error recovery is not taken over; the host-side wrapping of adapter metadata methods only supplements inference tier information and does not change any request endpoints or outbound channels.

checked_items.zh: 依赖均为 DeepSeek 官方作用域包（@deepseek-ai/*），未发现拼写仿冒或可疑包名；依赖版本以精确或较窄范围锁定。
checked_items.en: All dependencies are official DeepSeek scoped packages (@deepseek-ai/*), with no spelling impersonations or suspicious package names; dependency versions are locked with exact or narrow ranges.

checked_items.zh: 无安装钩子、无远程脚本即执行面；作者为个人账号且未认证（仅作身份加权观察，不单独判风险）。
checked_items.en: There are no install hooks and no remote script execution surface; the author is an individual account and unverified (noted only as an identity-weighted observation, not as an independent risk).

checked_items.zh: 安装文档建议以未钉 commit 的 #main 方式安装（更新可静默变更，属供应链卫生观察；市场安装命令仍按本次审计 commit 钉死，不受影响）。
checked_items.en: The installation documentation recommends installing via the #main branch without a pinned commit (updates can silently change, which is a supply-chain hygiene observation; the marketplace installation command remains pinned to this audit commit and is unaffected).

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用开关，也无用环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch file does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; it has no disable switches and no pattern of downgrading privileges via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 未对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件注册高优先级监听，不存在截断审批链的面；所用事件监听均为普通业务事件。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners are registered for security events such as pre-tool execution or approval requests, so there is no surface for truncating the approval chain; all used event listeners are ordinary business events.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法判定升级后自动激活突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit, with no previous version baseline for comparison, so it cannot be determined whether auto-activation mutations occurred after an upgrade.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务使其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite injection/interception configurations, so there is no surface for appending required services to security plugins to hang them.

checked_items.zh: 插件未启动 Web 服务、未监听端口，不产生本机无认证 RPC 面；宿主侧会向 pi-ai 设置段写入推理档位字典（热生效），属插件声明的核心功能且尊重用户已有声明。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on any port, so it does not create a local unauthenticated RPC surface; the host side writes an inference tier dictionary to the pi-ai settings section (hot-effective), which is a declared core function of the plugin and respects existing user declarations.

checked_items.zh: 本维度动态观测未启用（无动态沙箱产物），运行期行为未经沙箱验证，已如实标注于审计范围。
checked_items.en: Dynamic observation for this dimension is not enabled (no dynamic sandbox artifacts); runtime behavior has not been verified in a sandbox and is noted as such in the audit scope.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动任何 HTTP/WebSocket 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any HTTP/WebSocket service and does not listen on ports, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件标识、来源与声明核对一致：bundle patch 与浏览器端声明存在，名称无仿冒，作者为个人账号（未认证）。
summary.en: Plugin identity, source, and declarations are consistent: the bundle patch and browser-side declaration exist, the name shows no impersonation, and the author is an individual account (unverified).

summary.zh: 静态扫描全树：3 条机器命中已逐条复核并排除（构建产物长行、源码映射、测试加载器），运行时代码无危险调用面。
summary.en: Static scan of the entire tree: 3 machine hits were individually reviewed and excluded (build artifact long lines, source maps, test loader); the runtime code has no dangerous call surface.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无外联域名与命令行外发。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no outbound domains, and no command-line exfiltration.

summary.zh: 语义审查：无工具注册、无系统提示注入、无模型面指令文件，README 与注释未发现注入或诱导措辞。
summary.en: Semantic review: no tool registration, no system prompt injection, no model-facing instruction files, and no injection or inducement wording found in the README or comments.

summary.zh: 未做动态验证（无动态沙箱产物），运行时行为未经沙箱观测。
summary.en: No dynamic verification was performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts), and runtime behavior was not observed in a sandbox.

target.zh: dsh-effort-slider@0.2.5#b95d997a（full 审计，仓库根，非增量）

limits.zh:
1) DG-L4 动态沙箱未启用（无动态验证产物），运行时行为未经沙箱观测。

2) static-scan 预扫 3 条命中的逐条裁决：DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）@ lib/client.js:447 与 @ lib/client.js.map:1 为构建产物形态（内联样式表长行与源码映射单行 JSON），内容经核对为可读 CSS 与映射数据、无混淆或隐藏行为，排除；DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）@ test/client.smoke.mjs:41 为测试代码在模拟浏览器环境加载构建产物所用，非插件运行路径，排除。

3) lib/ 为已提交的构建产物（lib/index.js、lib/client.js、lib/client.js.map），未逐行通读，已通过对照 src/ 源码与全树检索验证行为一致。

4) 安装文档建议以未钉 commit 的 #main 方式安装（供应链卫生观察，市场安装命令仍按本次审计 commit 钉死）；作者为个人账号未认证（仅身份加权观察）。
limits.en:
1) DG-L4 dynamic sandbox is not enabled (no dynamic verification artifacts), and runtime behavior has not been observed in a sandbox.

2) Adjudication of the 3 static-scan pre-scan hits: DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) at lib/client.js:447 and at lib/client.js.map:1 are build artifact forms (inline style sheet long lines and source map single-line JSON); after review the contents are readable CSS and mapping data with no obfuscation or hidden behavior, so they are excluded. DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) at test/client.smoke.mjs:41 is test code used to load build artifacts in a simulated browser environment, not part of the plugin runtime path, so it is excluded.

3) lib/ contains committed build artifacts (lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/client.js.map) that were not read line-by-line; behavior consistency was verified by cross-referencing src/ source and a full-tree search.

4) The installation documentation recommends installing via the #main branch without a pinned commit (supply-chain hygiene observation; the marketplace installation command remains pinned to this audit commit); the author is an individual account and unverified (only an identity-weighted observation).
